mapper.select: SELECT A.menu_id ,A.menu ,A.premenuid ,A.menusort ,CASE WHEN B.btn_read='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS btn_read ,CASE WHEN B.btn_reg='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS btn_reg ,CASE WHEN B.btn_upd='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS btn_upd ,CASE WHEN B.btn_del='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS btn_del ,CASE WHEN B.btn_xlsd='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS btn_xlsd ,CASE WHEN B.btn_xlsu='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS btn_xlsu FROM ttok.cmm_menu A LEFT OUTER JOIN ttok.cmm_auth_menu B ON A.menu_id = B.menu_id AND B.auth_id = #{auth_id} WHERE A.useyn = 'Y' ORDER BY menusort
mapper.insert:
